phases.objective: Bind Governance DB Production preflight to the canonical Environment Authority without moving database credentials, grants, migration execution, or deployment authority into Spec 018.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Governance DB Production preflight before any principal provisioning, privilege readiness, or governed migration lifecycle
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The preflight requires a dedicated Governance DB identity and canonical Environment Authority with Production as both production branch and promotion target, exposes only no-secret readiness evidence, and performs no database connection, SQL, migration Apply, provider mutation, or deployment.
steps: Resolve and validate the dedicated GOVERNANCE_DB_USER and GOVERNANCE_DB_PASSWORD configuration without falling back to the ordinary runtime DB identity.
Load Environment Authority through the Spec 018 resolver.
Fail closed with a typed no-secret authority mismatch when either branch drifts.
Return bounded preflight evidence only after both independent authority domains pass.
assertions: Environment/branch authority and database mutation authority remain separate concerns.
A caller cannot treat main as the Production authority for Governance DB operations.
Runtime DB_USER and DB_PASSWORD never satisfy Governance writer identity requirements.
The preflight output contains no username or password values.
The preflight does not connect to MariaDB, execute SQL, apply a migration, mutate a provider, deploy, or restart runtime.
This integration depends on the Environment Authority foundation and does not move database provisioning into Spec 018.
